Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", "{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":false,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.5}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].detectedLanguages() as Any)
```
